aliases: ソル覚醒 (ソルかくせい
official_definition: You can put any amount of cores from your Field to this Spirit. When cores are put via this effect, once per turn, destroy an opposing Nexus.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Sol Awaken] or [Sol Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Sol Awaken]", "give [Sol Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
